issues.title: Ingest Madison County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $20,809,465 across 26 funds. The largest: Road & Bridge ($6,336,740), County General ($4,598,134), EMS 1% Sales Tax ($4,190,312). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
